deleteItemsOne: Delete {n} item from the library? Nodes already on the canvas keep their copy. You can undo this.
deleteItemsMany: Delete {n} items from the library? Nodes already on the canvas keep their copy. You can undo this.
tagsPrompt: Tags for "{name}" (comma separated; use a/b for nested tags)
renameTagPrompt: Rename tag "{tag}" for {locale} (other languages keep their names). Clear the text to delete the tag.
deleteTagConfirm: Delete tag "{tag}"? It is removed from every preset in this library.
deletePresetConfirm: Delete "{name}" from the library? Nodes already on the canvas keep their copy. You can undo this.
undoTip: Undo library delete (Ctrl+Z while the library list is focused)
thumbSize: Thumbnail size (or Shift + mouse wheel over the library)
newPreset: New preset in the first selected category
importWildcard: Import wildcard .txt (one entry per line) into the first selected category
selectMode: Selection mode: click toggles selection (Ctrl/Shift-click always works)
showTag: Show only {tag} {category} (click again to undo; Ctrl-click to add several; right-click to rename)
selectCategory: Select a category in the tree.
randomTip: Random pool of {title}. Drag onto the canvas (with several {title} selected, the pool is just those).
propsHint: Click a preset card (or select several) to edit them here. N toggles this pane.
